tasks.short: Upload the authorised customer image set to the correct website

steps.what: Read the actual customer order, locate its final image files and establish the requested website, customer account and permitted audience
inputs: Actual customer order and existing access instructions
outputs: Explicit file-to-order mapping and requested destination/access scope; missing permissions held

steps.what: Prepare an unsent upload package using the selected actual files, fixed website format rules and explicit destination mapping; list hashes, filenames, thumbnails and proposed access settings
inputs: Actual selected files and explicit mapping from s1
Existing website file-format and size requirements
outputs: Unsent exact upload package and manifest including destination, audience and file hashes

steps.what: Exercise the existing upload-release authority for the machine-prepared exact package: verify each customer/file association, requested audience, destination account and current permission before permitting transfer
inputs: Final unsent package and manifest from s2
Actual order and current permission from s1
outputs: Release decision bound to exact file hashes, destination and access settings, or a hold

steps.what: Upload only the released exact package to the specified customer website/account with its approved access settings; stop on changed files, changed permissions, wrong account or a failed transfer
outputs: Website transfer receipts and uploaded file identifiers, or a stopped failure

steps.what: Check actual transfer receipts, website file counts, image rendering and the customer access view; resolve partial or mismatched transfers before recording the actual result
outputs: Checked actual upload result entered in the existing order record

steps.what: Save the actual upload result in the same order system
inputs: Checked actual result entry from s5

tasks.design: Prepare the actual selected customer images for {CMS} using fixed format rules, then transfer the exact package only after the authorised uploader's current release decision. Retain original-order mapping, access judgment and actual website verification in {OPS_SYSTEM}; no model chooses images or infers consent.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated file formatting, manifest assembly and per-file portal transfers can require manual handling of an otherwise fixed customer image set.
tasks.enabler_now: A native batch uploader or permitted website API can accept a deterministic file package and return actual transfer identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: Wrong customer associations, unclear image permissions, unsuitable access settings and partial uploads require original evidence and a human release decision.
tasks.human_edge: The authorised worker establishes whose images may go to which customer account and verifies what actually arrived.

ambition.what: Complete the existing authorised upload accurately; do not infer a larger publishing service.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-3; confirm image access, current release authority and permitted website integration with their actual owners

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed image packaging and authenticated batch file upload are deterministic integration work; availability depends on the actual customer website and existing lab software.

assumptions: This is the upload episode for already-existing final images. The original customer order is the permission source, but s1 counts the worker's actual retrieval, file selection and destination/access mapping rather than assuming a clean upload feed.

The gate is an actual decision to disclose a machine-prepared file package to the requested account. The worker does not author the images or approve her own written report; no self-approval is added to ordinary author checking or to s6. This design applies only where that worker already holds upload-release authority; otherwise use the actual existing release owner and count that role's work, rather than invent a supervisor or delegate customer permission to the worker.

The exact package exists before s3. Any change to images, file hashes, account, audience or permission invalidates a1 and requires a fresh current release decision. Missing permission means hold, not automatic upload.

The actual transfer is s4. Packaging s2 never sends files. Post-transfer result capture occurs only after s4 and its verification; s6 is an ungated same-system save with minimum integer share 1 for negligible effort, fully retained and carrying no saving.

Shares are unmeasured work estimates, independent of the time-share prior. Baseline 100, retained 50, gross 50 points, less 5 new upkeep once gives 45. Existing image creation/editing and a customer's original permission decision are not claimed as savings.

Use the actual native batch upload and metadata presets first. Their existing runtime earns no new saving. The estimate applies only to observed manual packaging and portal transfer that these steps replace; already automated sites have no additional benefit.
No separate customer email is assumed. If the actual order requires one, its final text, existing release authority and actual send must be separately counted and gated.
unknowns: Existing native batch-upload support and permitted website API
Actual metadata restrictions and customer access model
Who already holds the final upload-release authority
research_questions: Observe one real order from final file selection through current release, actual upload and access verification; identify manual operations the native uploader already eliminates.

already_counted.description: Actual order/file mapping, current disclosure decision, post-transfer checking and ordinary result save

incremental.description: Maintain website format/access mappings, credentials and retry handling; test against portal changes

approvals.approved_version: Exact final s2 package hashes, file list, customer account, destination and audience, matched to current actual permission; any change voids release

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High: replace 25 packaging plus 25 transfer points, retaining all source mapping, release, website checking and save; 50 gross minus 5 upkeep =45. Low: website metadata lacks compatible output fields, retaining 15 of 25 packaging points, and portal restrictions retain 20 of 25 per-file transfer points; only 10+5=15 points are removed, minus 5 upkeep =10. These are explicit compatibility constraints, not a common percentage haircut.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Website owner confirms actual uploader access and supported transfer interface
skills_to_grow: Match actual customer permission to exact image files and audience
Check file manifests and actual transfer receipts
Recognise native batch upload before building integration
role.ambitious_version: A processing worker who transfers the correct authorised image set with less repetitive file handling while retaining the current disclosure decision and actual website checks.

job.title: Photographic Process Workers and Processing Machine Operators
